name: Hugo Ribeiro
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2015-2024); Hurun Global (2024-2026)
forbes_bio: Hugp Ribeiro is the son-in-law of Lucia Maggi, who cofounded Amaggi in 1997 with her late husband Andre Maggi.
Amaggi is one of Brazil's largest producers of soybeans and other commodities.
After Andre Maggi died in 2001, his son Blairo Maggi took over as the chief executive of the company.
Ribeiro is one of the controlling shareholders of Amaggi, along with Blairo Maggi, and Itamar Locks.
forbes_facts: Ribeiro previously served as president of the board at an Amaggi-linked research institute dedicated to developing more sustainable soybean varieties.
Amaggi produces approximately 1.2 million tons of soy, corn, and cotton in Brazil each year.

name: Tsai Chi-jui
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2019-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2021-2026)
forbes_bio: His Pou Chen Group, which he founded with his brothers in 1969, claims to be the largest branded athletic-and-casual-footwear-maker in the world.
The company makes more than 200 million pairs of shoes a year for such customers as Nike, Adidas, Asics and New Balance.
Tsai's daughter Pei-Chun has been CEO since 2012.
forbes_facts: The humble and intensely private son of Taiwanese weavers started as a textile worker and a primary school fine-arts teacher.
Tsai and his three brothers began by making rubber shoes.

name: Masayuki Ishihara
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2017-2023); Hurun Global (2020)
forbes_bio: Masayuki Ishihara draws his wealth from Tokyo-listed pachinko machine maker Heiwa.
Ishihara is not involved in running Heiwa.
He founded another pachinko firm, Olympia, which Heiwa acquired in a stock swap in 2007.
Heiwa subsidiary PGM is one of Japan's largest golf course operators.

name: Eric Ya Shen
sec_insider_companies: Vipshop Holdings Ltd (VIPS) - Chief Executive Officer
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2015-2025); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Shen is a co-founder and largest shareholder of Vipshop, a Chinese e-commerce company.
From 2010 to 2012 Shen was chairman of Guangzhou NEM Import and Export, a consumer electronics business.
Shen holds an executive MBA degree from Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business and an associate degree in telecommunication from Shanghai Railway College.

name: Xie Bingzheng
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2023); Hurun Global (2022-2024); Hurun China (2017-2026)
forbes_bio: Xie Bingzheng chairs and is the founder of Biem.L.Fdlkk Garment, a Chinese golf apparel brand and retailer.
Xie founded Biem.L.Fdlkk in the southern Chinese city of Guangdong in 2003.
The quirky name and brand is meant to resonate with Chinese customers seeking a foreign brand.
Biem.L.Fdlkk apparel is sold in about 1,000 shops around China.

name: Clemens Fischer
forbes_bio: Clemens Fischer is serial pharmaceutical and supplement entrepreneur who owns the Futrue Group, a Munich-based holding company with a collection of about 20 drug and R&D companies.
Over the last two decades, he has built and sold a series of companies in the over-the-counter drug and supplement space, from sleep aids to irritable bowel syndrome treatments.
Fischer's newest company is Vertanical, the Munich-based pharmaceutical company developing a cannabinoid-based extract to treat chronic pain.
Vertanical is pursuing approval for its drug Ver-01 in the European Union and eventually in the United States with hopes for it to become the first cannabis-based prescription painkiller.
Born in Weilheim, Germany, Fischer became a medical doctor but stopped practicing medicine decades ago to get an MBA from Harvard and become an entrepreneur.

name: Rajinder Gupta
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2022-2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026); Hurun India (2016-2019)
forbes_bio: Rajinder Gupta is the founder of Trident, a company known for its home textiles, paper and chemicals.
The Ludhiana-based company makes bath and bed linen such as towels, duvets and fitted sheets.
Two-thirds of Trident's annual revenue is from exports to more than 150 countries.
Trident has factories in the Indian states of Punjab and Madhya Pradesh.
He resigned as chairman in 2022 citing health reasons and family issues.
forbes_facts: He founded it in 1990 as a yarn manufacturer.
Trident is among the top five terry towel makers in the world.

name: Benny Suherman
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2024); Hurun Global (2024-2025)
forbes_bio: Benny Suherman is a cofounder and the majority owner of Nusantara Sejahtera Raya, which runs Cinema XXI, Indonesia's largest cinema chain.
Cinema XXI operates nearly 1,300 screens in 240 locations across the country.
Suherman took the company public in 2023 in a $150 million IPO.
His sons Suryo and Arif are Nusantara Sejahtera Raya's president director and director, respectively; daughter Melia is commissioner.
forbes_facts: In 1987 Suherman opened Studio 21, the precursor of Cinema XXI and the country's first ever cinema chain.
